notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
The time has come at last!

Fowl Swarm is now officially released into Early Access!
As a bonus, the game will have a 10% launch discount for 1 week!

I've been developing this game as a side project for about a year, so I'm excited to finally get it into the hands of players.

As I would like to work closely with the community to develop the game further, I have created a suggestions chat and a bug reporting chat in the discord server - feel free to join: Fowl Swarm Discord Server

I do have some planned features already which are at the planning stage and I will announce those features in due time, so stay tuned!

As a bit of a recap as to what is already in the game:

 Leaderboards
 Stats
 Discord Rich Presence Integration
 Achievements
 Endless
 Chickens will occasionally lay eggs which will spawn baby chickens at the start of the next wave.
 Chickens can drop chicken drumsticks - Pick them up to regain some health
 Chickens at less than 50% health will lose their head
 Headless chickens will lose health over time


Join the Fowl Swarm Discord Server
 - Wilobate

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Here We Go!

At last, I have what we have all been waiting for, the release date for Fowl Swarm!

After a long journey I am now happy to release Fowl Swarm into Early Access, and with the help of the community, we can take the game in the direction we all want to see!

If you haven't already, make sure you wishlist Fowl Swarm and we will see you on 18th October at 12:00 AEDT for the release!

Join the Fowl Swarm Discord Server
 - Wilobate

notes.title: Getting Close Now!
notes.content:
We are so close!

After much work being done, we are nearing the time of when the game will be released into early access!

While I'm not quite ready to announce a release date, keep your eyes out because that announcement will be made real soon!

If you haven't already, be sure to wishlist Fowl Swarm!

This is a small list of what I have to do and what I'm currently working on

Animations - The big one as this is the first time I'm animating, bring on the jank ːcsgoanarchistː
Adding and tweaking a couple small features
Bug fixes should they arise 


I already have some plans for more content after the early access release which I can't wait to share when the time comes. I'm also looking forward to receiving your feedback and ideas!
